observations.command: /bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' AGENTS.md && sed -n '1,300p' client/AGENTS.md && sed -n '1,320p' client/CONTEXT.md && sed -n '1,320p' .rsp/changes/device-discovery-boundary.md && printf '\\n--- target exists ---\\n' && (test -e docs/architecture/device-discovery-boundary.md && sed -n '1,320p' docs/architecture/device-discovery-boundary.md || true) && printf '\\n--- worktree ---\\n' && git status --short"

/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n --glob '"'!node_modules'"' 'projectDeviceEvent|device discovery|device-discovery|DeviceEvent|connected' client docs .rsp package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml 2>/dev/null | head -n 240 && printf '\\n--- layouts ---\\n' && rg --files client docs .rsp | rg '("'^client/(packages|desktop|web)|architecture|device)'"' | head -n 240 && printf '\\n--- change refs ---\\n' && rg -n 'WorkRef|device-discovery-boundary' .rsp docs client 2>/dev/null | head -n 120 && printf '\\n--- commands ---\\n' && rg -n 'device-discovery|\"test\"|mise' package.json client/package.json client/**/package.json 2>/dev/null"

/bin/zsh -lc "find . -maxdepth 4 -type f -not -path './.git/*' -print | sort | head -n 240 && printf '\\n--- package/test ---\\n' && sed -n '1,180p' package.json && sed -n '1,220p' test/device-discovery.test.mjs && sed -n '1,160p' client/packages/device-discovery/src/index.ts && printf '\\n--- git history ---\\n' && git log --oneline -8 --all -- .rsp/changes/device-discovery-boundary.md docs/architecture/device-discovery-boundary.md 2>/dev/null"
/bin/zsh -lc 'mise exec -- pnpm test -- device-discovery && git diff --check && git diff -- docs/architecture/device-discovery-boundary.md && git status --short'

/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && git status --short && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'AGENTS.override.md' -g 'CONTEXT.md' -g 'device-discovery-boundary.md' -g '*.md' .rsp client docs | sed -n '1,240p' && npx -y @oevery/rsp status --json && npx -y @oevery/rsp check --focused && npx -y @oevery/rsp show --focused --json"

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' client/AGENTS.md && sed -n '1,280p' client/CONTEXT.md && sed -n '1,320p' .rsp/changes/device-discovery-boundary.md && sed -n '1,360p' docs/architecture/device-discovery-boundary.md && (test -f .rsp/specs/design.md && sed -n '1,280p' .rsp/specs/design.md || true) && rg -n -i -C 3 'device discovery|discovery|receiver|hardware' client docs .rsp --glob '"'!**/node_modules/**'"'"

/bin/zsh -lc "rg --files | sed -n '1,320p' && find client -maxdepth 4 -type f | sort | sed -n '1,320p' && (test -f package.json && sed -n '1,220p' package.json || true) && (test -f client/package.json && sed -n '1,260p' client/package.json || true) && rg -n \"projectDeviceEvent|device-discovery|describe\\(|test\\(\" client --glob '"'!**/node_modules/**'"'"

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,220p' client/packages/device-discovery/src/index.ts && sed -n '1,280p' test/device-discovery.test.mjs && git diff -- client/packages/device-discovery/src/index.ts test/device-discovery.test.mjs .rsp/changes/device-discovery-boundary.md && git diff --check"
